stories.title: BMC seeks nod to pay Rs 3.2cr metro cess to clear path for textile museum in Mazgaon
stories.summary: The payment is to be made to the Mumbai city collector’s office for the cess applicable on the land transfer document. 34-sqm mill to BMC on Jan 7, 2009, under Regulation 58 of Development Control Rules, 1991, for its development as a recreation ground. In Dec 2016, the state urban development department (UDD) directed that 44,000sqm of the land be reserved for a recreation ground and a textile museum.

stories.title: Eight rescued, firefighter injured in fire at south Mumbai residential building
stories.summary: Eight people, including two children, were rescued after a fire broke out at a four-storey residential building in south Mumbai in the early hours of Sunday. A firefighter sustained injuries during the rescue operation, officials said. 07 am at Hira Manzil, located on Gildar Lane near Navjivan Society in Mumbai Central.

stories.title: Tiger Shroff makes first public appearance since firing incident, performs Deva Shree Ganesha at Global Peace Honours 2026
stories.summary: Tiger Shroff was back on stage at the Global Peace Honours 2026 in Mumbai on Saturday, making his first public performance since the alleged firing incident involving his vehicle in October. The actor performed to Deva Shree Ganesha from Agneepath at the event, held against the iconic backdrop of the Gateway of India.

stories.title: Mumbai Police to issue cards with QR code for identity checks
stories.summary: Mumbai Police will issue cards with QR code and NFC to personnel, and citizens can scan the code through the Mumbai Police Citizen App to check a person’s photograph, name, date of joining and posting, a measure that follows cases in which fraudsters posed as police and sought money from citizens.

stories.title: Western Railway motormen, train managers participate in WNC Navy Half Marathon
stories.summary: Train managers and motormen from Western Railway participated in the WNC Navy Half Marathon 2026 in Mumbai on Sunday, November 22, completing the 5 km and 10 km running categories. The railway employees took part in the event despite their demanding operational schedules, which involve ensuring the safe movement of trains throughout the year.

stories.title: Mumbai local train update: Mega block on central, Harbour and Western Railway lines today; services to be affected
stories.summary: 10pm. 58pm will run on the slow corridor till Thane before being re-diverted to the fast line at Mulund. 40 pm. 35pm on Sunday for maintenance of tracks, signalling and overhead equipment. Slow trains will run on fast lines during the block.

stories.title: Mumbai Navy Half Marathon draws over 22,000 runners from India and abroad
stories.summary: More than 22,000 runners, including 59 participants from 20 foreign countries, took part in the ninth edition of the Indian Oil WNC Navy Half Marathon 2026, organised by the Indian Navy in Mumbai on Sunday, November 22. The event began at Cross Maidan, with participants competing in three categories: the 21-km Aircraft Carrier Run, the 10-km Destroyer Run and the 5-km Frigate Run.

stories.title: Thief breaks into St Andrew’s Church, steals ₹15,000 in donation money
stories.summary: A thief broke into St Andrew’s Church in Bandra (west) and stole the cash from five donation boxes, leaving the local community shaken. According to the First Information Report (FIR) filed by parish priest Father Nigel Barrett, the theft took place between 11 pm on Friday and 5 am on Saturday after the burglar broke open a window and gained entry to the church.

stories.title: BMC scraps underground passage below Mahalaxmi Racecourse, ₹702-crore Metro-Coastal Road link to be redesigned
stories.summary: Amid opposition from architects and urban planners to Mahalaxmi Racecourse’s proposed redevelopment as part of the big-ticket Central Park project, BMC has decided to scrap all underground construction below the iconic landmark. The link, which was originally planned to pass beneath the racecourse, will now run entirely above ground adjoining the walking pathway of the racecourse stretch.

stories.title: Bombay HC Allows Chembur Society Redevelopment, Says Members Cannot Be Made To Wait Over 15-Year-Old Dispute
stories.summary: (Representative Image) Mumbai: Observing that members of a Chembur housing society have been left in the lurch for nearly 15 years after vacating their homes for redevelopment, the Bombay High Court has said they cannot be made to wait indefinitely for the outcome of prolonged legal proceedings.

stories.title: 30-Crore worth Musical Fountain Show to be developed at Powai lake
stories.summary: Mumbai ’s Powai Lake is set to become a major tourist attraction with the introduction of a ₹30-crore musical fountain and multimedia light-and-sound show celebrating the history of the Maratha Empire and the legacy of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. The project has been developed to enhance the city’s tourism infrastructure while offering visitors a combination of cultural storytelling and modern technology.

stories.title: BMC drops underground development at Mahalaxmi Racecourse
stories.summary: The civic administration has decided to scrap the ambitious underground component of the reimagined Mahalaxmi Racecourse plan, signalling a victory for urban planners and architects advocating for the city of Mumbai. While overground landscaped gardens and recreational spaces will remain part of the plan, Olympic-level sports facilities and a massive parking bay, which were to occupy two underground levels, have been dropped.

stories.title: Mumbai BJP wants BMC to maintain all open spaces, develop international sports facilities in 2-3 playgrounds in every ward
stories.summary: Among the BJP functionaries who attended the meeting that decided against any third-party rights over recreation grounds in the city were ministers Ashish Shelar and Mangal Prabhat Lodha, city BJP chief Ameet Satam, senior MLAs and corporators. BMC's earlier open spaces policy was scrapped in 2016 by CM Devendra Fadnavis, who directed the civic body to take back open spaces handed over to private players under previous policies.

stories.title: BMC To Replace 400 Damaged Manhole Covers Across Mumbai At ₹1.10 Crore
stories.summary: 10 Crore | File Pic Mumbai: With broken, missing and damaged manhole covers posing a serious threat to pedestrians and motorists, the BMC has moved to replace covers on 400 manholes across Mumbai at an estimated cost of Rs. 10 crore. The move comes amid growing concerns over public safety and the risks posed by uncovered or damaged manholes on the city's roads and footpaths.

stories.title: Felling of Versova trees: Why take up Coastal Road infrastructure work away from sea, asks Congress neta
stories.summary: Extending his support to locals protesting against the felling of 44 mature trees in Versova’s Nani Park for a double-decker bridge planned as part of the Mumbai Coastal Road-North project, Congress corporator Ashraf Azmi on Sunday said he will raise the issue at an upcoming meeting of BMC’s standing committee.

stories.title: Eight minors detained for assaulting couple in Kurla garden
stories.summary: A teenage couple was allegedly abused, assaulted and driven out of a municipal garden in Kurla by a group of boys on Friday evening, police said. The Ghatkopar police have detained eight minors in connection with the assault after a video of the incident surfaced on social media.

stories.title: BMC Clears Mobile High-Mast Lights For Deonar Dumping Amid Corporators' Questions Over Availability, Cost Hike
stories.summary: With Deonar’s biomining and Waste-to-Energy projects yet to become operational, the BMC has approved vehicle-mounted high-mast lights to facilitate night-time dumping operations. However, the proposal came under fire at the recent Standing Committee meeting, with corporators questioning the equipment’s actual availability, necessity and a steep hike in contractor rates.

stories.title: 420-metre Poisar River stretch to get protective wall in ₹9 crore flood-control project
stories.summary: 08 crore to address recurring flooding in Hanuman Nagar, a low-lying locality that has witnessed flood-like situations during heavy rainfall over the past few years. Overflowing river water often inundates adjoining lanes and homes, disrupting daily life and making it difficult for residents to move around during the monsoon.

stories.title: Human Rights Complaint Filed Against Woman Constable For Allegedly Bursting Firecrackers Inside Andheri Police
stories.summary: Mumbai: A complaint has been filed with the Human Rights Commission against a woman police constable for allegedly bursting firecrackers inside the Andheri Police Station premises. Advocate Ashish Rai has lodged the complaint, alleging that the woman constable celebrated the transfer of a senior police inspector by bursting firecrackers inside the police station.

stories.title: Six sent to juvenile home after Mumbai assault; Maharashtra SP leader seeks age change
stories.summary: A juvenile court ordered that six persons in the 12- to 15-year-old age group be placed in a juvenile home until December 4, after Ghatkopar police detained eight persons below 18 in connection with an assault on a couple at Pramod Mahajan Garden in Kurla on Friday evening (November 20, 2026) and produced all eight before the Juvenile Justice Board, police said.

stories.title: Video call helped reassure family of four stranded on third floor of Mumbai Central building during midnight fire; eight rescued
stories.summary: A video call helped reassure a family of four, including two children, stranded on the upper floor of a three-storey building in Mumbai Central as fire raged below them shortly after midnight on Sunday. 07am. Fire brigade personnel, officers, a turntable ladder, an ambulance and other equipment were deployed.

stories.title: Relief for over 3,000 flat buyers as National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission holds developer of Mumbai project guilty of deficiency in service for decade-long delay in possession
stories.summary: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC) has held the developer of D B Ozone project in Dahisar guilty of deficiency in service and unfair trade practice over delayed possession, failure to provide promised amenities and other alleged violations, offering relief to more than 3,300 homebuyers waiting for over a decade.The developer, Neelkamal Realtors Suburban, has filed a special leave petition in Supreme Court even as the buyers filed a caveat before the apex court after…

stories.title: Raut alleges Rs 150 cr per MP to pass Delimitation Bill; BJP responds
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut on Sunday accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of attempting to buy MPs from other political parties to secure the numbers required to pass the proposed Delimitation Bill in Parliament. He alleged that the BJP was offering Rs 150 crore for each MP who switches sides, reported the IANS.

stories.title: '90 seats, one crore votes': Revanth Reddy sets Congress' 2028 Telangana target
stories.summary: Telangana chief minister A Revanth Reddy on Sunday expressed confidence that the Congress would return to power in the state by winning 90 of the 119 Assembly seats in the 2028 elections.

stories.title: Bisleri Under Scanner After Carcinogenic Substances Found In Water Sample
stories.summary: FSSAI has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri over a sample of packaged drinking water that was found non-compliant with prescribed bromate limits and declared unsafe under Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. The Referral Food Laboratory too declared it unsafe after detecting polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons. Vasant Masala Pvt Ltd was prosecuted after its chilli powder was found to contain difenoconazole, a pesticide residue, above the allowed limit.

stories.title: Worker dies after falling from fifth floor of under-construction building in Chakan
stories.summary: “Dhurve and other workers were on the fifth floor of the building on Saturday morning, where a slab was to be constructed. Dhurve was fixing a channel for the lift when he lost his balance and fell to the ground.

stories.title: BJP Rajya Sabha MP Ramrao Wadkute dies of cardiac arrest in Delhi
stories.summary: BJP Rajya Sabha MP Ramrao Sakharam Wadkute, who was elected to the Upper House earlier this year, died following a cardiac arrest at a hospital in New Delhi, family sources said on Sunday (November 22, 2026). Mr. Wadkute was admitted to AIIMS in the national capital on November 20 after complaining of a cough.

stories.title: Bengal BJP MLA Rekha Patra critical after suspected pesticide poisoning
stories.summary: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MLA from Hingalganj in West Bengal’s North 24 Parganas, Rekha Patra, was on Sunday (November 22, 2026) admitted to a private hospital in the city after falling ill from suspected pesticide poisoning. The MLA was admitted to Basirhat Subdivision Hospital, from where she was shifted to the private facility.

stories.title: Police in Karnataka prevent Andhra Pradesh Congress Committee chief Y.S. Sharmila from entering disputed property
stories.summary: S. S. Jagan Mohan Reddy, from entering a disputed property in Yelahanka, citing an interim injunction order issued by a court in Devanahalli. Ms. Sharmila was stopped by the police at Bagalur Road in Yelahanka while she was travelling towards Yelahanka Palace at Kattigenahalli village in Jala hobli, Bengaluru North taluk.

stories.title: Amritsar grenade attack: US-based Happy Passia, 8 others declared proclaimed offenders
stories.summary: US-based gangster-terrorist associated with Babbar Khalsa International (BKI), Harpeet Singh alias Passia, and eight others have been declared proclaimed offenders (POs) in connection with a grenade attack at a police station in Punjab’s Gurdaspur in April last year. The order for declaring them POs was passed by a special National Investigation Agency (NIA) court in Mohali on Saturday based on a request by the agency.

stories.title: West Bengal BJP president Samik Bhattacharya calls for protest over attacks on Hindus in Bangladesh
stories.summary: West Bengal Bharatiya Janata Party ( BJP ) president Samik Bhattacharya on Sunday (November 22, 2026) called for a protest against the alleged persecution of Hindus in Bangladesh . “Blood is being shed in Bangladesh, and it is our brothers who are suffering. As a Bengali Hindu, I believe we must take to the streets,” the BJP leader told media persons.

stories.title: Maharashtra scales down tree plantation drive amid severe drought, says Fadnavis
stories.summary: Maharashtra has scaled down its tree-plantation drive this year due to acute water shortages caused by severe drought conditions across several districts, Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said on Saturday. Speaking at an event in the presence of spiritual leader Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev, Fadnavis said that 80-90 per cent of rural Maharashtra was facing drought and a severe water crisis.

stories.title: "Anti-Hindu": BJP On Tamil Nadu Government's Deepam Order Review Plea
stories.summary: The BJP on Sunday said the Tamil Nadu government's move to seek a review of a Supreme Court order permitting the lighting of the traditional Karthigai Deepam lamp on November 24 as a one-time measure at Deepathoon reflects an "anti-Hindu and anti-Sanatan Dharma" mindset of the Congress and its allies.

stories.title: Centre prioritising border villages, 40 seeing reverse migration: Amit Shah in Arunachal Pradesh
stories.summary: Describing the development of border villages as a priority of the government, Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Sunday (November 22, 2026) said the upliftment of about 40 villages along the International Border in Arunachal Pradesh , under the Centre’s flagship Vibrant Villages Programme (VVP), ensured that many of those who moved out from these areas were returning.

stories.title: Manipur hooch tragedy toll rises to 17; sample sent to Kolkata lab
stories.summary: The death toll in Manipur’s hooch tragedy rose to 17 on Sunday (November 22, 2026), as the State government sent samples of the suspected spurious liquor produced locally to the National Food Laboratory in Kolkata for testing. Government spokesperson and MLA Thokchom Radheshyam Singh said 16 people who died after consuming the liquor were from Chandel district and one was from Kakching district.

stories.title: Hyderabad Police issue alert over terror threat email; security checks conducted at key locations
stories.summary: The Hyderabad Police issued a precautionary alert following a reported terror threat warning of possible bomb blasts at two locations in the city, including Hotel Tourist Plaza in Kacheguda and Kacheguda Railway Station. The sender also threatened to replicate the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks in Hyderabad. A senior police official told The Hindu that the message appeared to be a hoax.

stories.title: 24 civilians killed in fresh South Sudan violence | Hindustan Times
stories.summary: A weekend attack by opposition forces in volatile South Sudan killed 24 civilians, including seven children, local authorities said Sunday. The world's youngest country, which gained independence in 2011, has been torn apart by violence between rival political factions, often linked to ethnicity or cattle rustling.

stories.title: Bengal BJP MLA Rekha Patra, face of Sandeshkali stir, hospitalised with food poisoning
stories.summary: Rekha Patra, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) legislator from West Bengal’s Hingalganj, was hospitalised on Saturday night with symptoms of food poisoning , health minister Sharadwat Mukherjee said on Sunday after visiting the private hospital in Kolkata where Patra was on a ventilator. “I inquired about her health.

stories.title: Maharashtra FDA warns against misleading health claims, illegal supplement sales
stories.summary: Focusing on supplements, nutraceuticals, and other such substances, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has issued a statewide comprehensive compliance order that must be adhered to by manufacturers, brand owners, importers, distributors, warehouses, retailers, pharmacies, gymnasiums, hospital suppliers and e-commerce entities alike. Even influencers who promote such materials under false claims will be sent notices by the body.

stories.title: Maharashtra to upgrade 3,832 anganwadis with smart classrooms, modern kitchens
stories.summary: Maharashtra will upgrade 3,832 anganwadi centres across the state under a government initiative to improve infrastructure and provide children with better learning facilities, Women and Child Development Minister Aditi Tatkare said on Sunday. The centres will be equipped with e-learning tools, rainwater harvesting systems, modern kitchens and other facilities as part of the plan to develop them into smart anganwadis.

stories.title: Kasimedu fisherfolk withdraw strike after Minister’s intervention
stories.summary: Fishermen of Kasimedu on Sunday withdrew their indefinite strike, seeking the release of eight boats impounded by the Andhra Pradesh government, after the intervention of Finance Minister N. Marie Wilson, who is also the MLA for Dr. Radhakrishnan Nagar Assembly constituency. The Minister, who reached the fishing harbour on Sunday morning, interacted with the leaders of various associations, and listened to their grievances for about an hour.

stories.title: Nirmala Sitharaman Column: 'The decade India turned the tide on poverty’
stories.summary: A year ago, during my visit to Kiphire, an aspirational district in the remote hills of Nagaland, I interacted with tribal women from local self-help groups. Among them was Esther, a Lakhpati Didi , who proudly spoke of her millet-based products reaching customers online, far beyond Nagaland. What stayed with me was their confidence in a better future.

stories.title: Go public or stay private: Tata Sons gears up for decision this week
stories.summary: Tata Sons is heading into one of its most consequential weeks in decades. The six-member board is already divided, with Trusts chairman Noel Tata, a director of Tata Sons, opposed to an IPO while the other five directors favour compliance with RBI's listing requirement.

stories.title: Indian supply chains may have $500 billion in inventory tied up: Kinaxis CEO
stories.summary: Around $500 billion worth of inventory is stuck in India’s supply chains, according to Razat Gaurav, chief executive officer of Canadian enterprise software company Kinaxis. He said Indian companies had considerable scope to improve supply-chain planning, balance demand with supply and free up working capital. “In our estimation, there’s about $500 billion of inventory stuck in India’s supply chains,” Mr.

stories.title: 8 Killed, 2 Injured As Car Rams Tree In Tamil Nadu's Tiruchirapalli
stories.summary: Eight people were killed and two others seriously injured after the car they were travelling in rammed into a neem tree in Tamil Nadu's Tiruchirappalli district on Sunday, police said.The accident occurred around 4.05pm near Kothurpatty Four Roads, within the limits of Jambunathapuram police station.The 10 occupants were returning to Thirukattupalli in Thanjavur district after attending an ear-piercing ceremony at Erumapatti in Namakkal district, police said.Five occupants died on the spot, while three others succumbed…

stories.title: Patrick and Brittany Mahomes' $325M stadium investment fuels NWSL title success
stories.summary: Kansas City Current's first NWSL Championship rewarded its owners' long-term investment in women's soccer infrastructure. Patrick and Brittany Mahomes were part of the ownership group that backed the club's purpose-built stadium and training facility. Angie Long said the facilities gave the team a sense of permanence and relevance.

stories.title: Miley Cyrus struggled to hold back tears while exchanging vows with Maxx Morando; newlyweds share romanti
stories.summary: Miley Cyrus has married musician Maxx Morando in an intimate wedding ceremony in Palm Springs, California, surrounded by family and close friends. One of the most meaningful moments of the day was reportedly seeing Miley's family come together to celebrate her wedding. Her parents, Tish Cyrus and Billy Ray Cyrus, were both present, along with her sister Noah Cyrus.

stories.title: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992 after flipping North Carolina seat
stories.summary: The Democratic Party has won the largest majority in the US House of Representatives since 1992, after Democrat Chuck Hubbard unseated Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in North Carolina. The race was called on Sunday, with Hubbard beating Foxx by 330 votes with 99% counted. It was one of the closest contests of the recent midterm elections, in which Democrats also secured the Senate.

stories.title: COP31 talks fail as EU, others reject any climate deal without language on a fossil fuel phase-out
stories.summary: A standoff on a fossil fuel phase-out prevented countries at COP 31, the United Nations climate talks in Antalya, Turkiye, from achieving any consensus agreement on future climate action on Sunday (November 22, 2026), despite the conference running a record 48 hours into overtime. The European Union led objections to COP 31 President Murat Kurum’s consensus cover text that failed to include any explicit language about moving away from fossil fuels.

stories.title: UN climate talks collapse without a deal
stories.summary: The longest UN climate summit in history ended without a deal in Turkiye, the first such failure since 2009. Talks collapsed over fossil fuels and climate financing, with nations rejecting a draft that omitted fossil fuels and offered little new funding for vulnerable countries.

stories.title: Italian jeweller and businessman Paolo Bulgari dies aged 89
stories.summary: Italian jeweller Paolo Bulgari, who helped turn his family's business into a global luxury brand, has died in Rome aged age 89. His family announced the news, remembering him as "the greatest jeweller of our time", according to Italian media. Paolo Bulgari was Chairman of the Bvlgari Group since 1984 and its jewellery pieces have adorned Hollywood stars and royalty including Diana, Princess of Wales.

stories.title: FSSAI orders prosecution against Bisleri International for unsafe packaged drinking water
stories.summary: Food regulator FSSAI on Sunday (November 22, 2026) said it has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International, as it found its sample of packaged drinking water "unsafe". In a social media post, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) said it has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International Pvt Ltd regarding "unsafe packaged drinking water".

stories.title: Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory
stories.summary: At least three people have been killed and 36 are still missing after a fire at a confectionary factory in western Java on Saturday. Firefighters were still tackling some flames on Sunday, while rescuers searched for the missing in parts of the damaged building where workers were believed to be trapped.

stories.title: Suspected Ukrainian sea drones hit Russian warship at Benghazi naval base, Libyan officials say
stories.summary: A suspected Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship on Sunday (November 22, 2026) at a naval base in Libya, officials said, the latest attack in the North African nation linked to the Russia-Ukraine war. The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said.

stories.title: PM Modi, Nepal's Balendra Shah to launch direct Ayodhya-Janakpur train today
stories.summary: 40 pm (Nepali time) on Tuesday. 10 am on Sunday. The train will pass through Mankapur, Basti, Gorakhpur, Narkatiaganj, Raxaul, Sitamarhi, Shisho, Madhubani and Jaynagar. It will operate with modern 17-coach LHB rakes, comprising eight AC coaches, seven sleeper coaches, one luggage and disabled-friendly coach, and one power car.

stories.title: Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say
stories.summary: An explosion has occurred on a Russian ship docked at Benghazi naval base port after a suspected drone attack, Libya's eastern government has said. The explosion happened at dawn on Sunday, while the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia, Libyan state media reported, citing the eastern government.

stories.title: Australian music legend Molly Meldrum dies aged 83
stories.summary: The music promoter and broadcaster, born Ian Alexander Meldrum, helped define the nation's music tastes for decades, championing local artists like INXS and Kylie Minogue and global acts like Abba. Known for his chaotic demeanour and trademark Stetson hat, he interviewed an array of stars from King Charles to Elton John, who described Meldrum as the "single most important influence in Australian pop music".

stories.title: Netanyahu, Eisenkot parties end talks without deal on forming Israel government
stories.summary: The parties of caretaker Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his rival Gadi Eisenkot concluded a new round of talks on Sunday (November 22, 2026) without reaching an agreement on a possible coalition government, which would require concessions from both sides. Delegations from Eisenkot's Yashar party and Netanyahu's Likud met for four hours at a hotel in Herzliya, near Tel Aviv, following a first round of discussions last Sunday (November 22).

stories.title: Balen Shah India visit highlights: ‘India cherishes special friendship with Nepal,’ says Jaishankar on meeting Nepal PM
stories.summary: Nepal Prime Minister Balendra Shah met external affairs minister S Jaishankar. Nepalese Prime Minister Balen Shah arrived in New Delhi on Sunday evening on his maiden official visit to India after taking charge in March. A traditional folk performance added a cultural touch to Shah's welcome in India, with Uttarakhand artists presenting the region's indigenous Tandi dance, also known as the Jaunsari song and dance.

stories.title: US Intelligence Chief Says Putin Is 'Not America's Friend In Ukraine'
stories.summary: ""He is not America's friend in Ukraine. Trump later defended his remarks, arguing that "it's nice to have people that have 4,000 nuclear weapons as a friend as opposed to an enemy." "The Russia-Ukraine war began in February 2022 and Moscow currently controls about a fifth of its neighbouring country's territory.

stories.title: Tempers flare! Pakistan player gives Harshit Rana a fiery send-off, teammate steps in
stories.summary: India A pacer Harshit Rana was at the centre of a heated exchange with Pakistan A players during their Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 match at the West End Park International Cricket Stadium in Doha on Sunday. Rana was dismissed for a duck in the 45th over. As he made his way off the field, Moqim appeared to say something to him.

stories.title: Boy, 7, pulled alive from rubble hours after Russian strike on Ukraine, rescuers say
stories.summary: A seven-year-old boy has been rescued from the rubble of a residential building near Kyiv 14 hours after a Russian strike, Ukraine's state emergency service in the capital region has said. The attack early on Sunday morning in the village of Dymer killed six people, Kyiv's regional head Tymur Tkachenko said.

stories.title: 'Iran sees Democrats as weak': Trump links surge in attacks to US midterm wins
stories.summary: US president Donald Trump has claimed that Iran intensified its drone and missile attacks following the Democratic Party's victories in the November 3 midterm elections. In a post on his Truth Social platform on Monday, Trump linked the alleged escalation in Iranian attacks to the Democrats securing control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate.

stories.title: 'Danger seems greater all the time': Ukrainians search for missing after Russian strikes
stories.summary: Close At least three bodies have been recovered the site of a residential building that was hit by a Russian strike in the Kyiv region, Ukraine's State Emergency Services said. A woman in her forties and a teenage boy have so far been identified as rescue workers continue to search the rubble for those who are still trapped.

stories.title: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in California ceremony
stories.summary: Miley Cyrus has married her partner of four years Maxx Morando during a ceremony in Palm Springs, California. A string of black and white photos shared by the Flowers singer on Instagram showed the pair kissing while surrounded by white roses. Her mother, Trisha Cyrus, and sister, Noah Cyrus, could be seen in the background of one image.

stories.title: Alcaraz charges past world number one Zverev to clinch ATP Finals title
stories.summary: Seven-time Grand Slam champion Carlos Alcaraz powered past world number one ​Alexander Zverev 6-2 7-6(7) on Sunday (November 22, 2026) to win his maiden ATP Finals ⁠title. S. Open after a four-month break due to a wrist injury, saved three set points in the tiebreak before completing his 14th consecutive victory and ending ‌the year with a third straight title, having also triumphed in Vienna and Paris.

stories.title: Marquez wins record-equalling eighth MotoGP title
stories.summary: Marc Marquez clinched a record-equalling eighth MotoGP championship with an eighth-placed finish in the Portuguese Grand Prix on Sunday. The Spaniard needed to finish in the top nine on his Ducati to seal a second consecutive championship and move level with legendary Italian Giacomo Agostini on eight titles.

stories.title: Key UN Climate Talks That Ended In Deadlock Or Failure
stories.summary: The failure of COP31 climate talks in Antalya is the latest in a string of disappointments at major UN environmental summits since the first Conference of the Parties, or COP, in 1995. Various previous summits have descended into acrimony or even failed completely over a lack of consensus.

From the show Reading time 2 min A viral video appearing to show China's Xi Jinping "snubbing" Vladimir Putin at the APEC summit has racked up millions of views, fuelling speculation about tensions between Beijing and Moscow.

stories.title: Nepal PM Balendra Shah arrives in Delhi for first official visit to India
stories.summary: The Prime Minister of Nepal, Balendra Shah, arrived here on Sunday (November 22, 2026) afternoon for his first official visit to India. Sources said that Mr. Shah will inaugurate several projects on Monday and is scheduled to hold talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi. According to sources, Monday’s (November 23, 2026) discussion between the two Prime Ministers will give “political direction” to bilateral relations for the coming years.

stories.title: Price wins Grand Slam to end wait for major title
stories.summary: Gerwyn Price ended his four-year wait for a major PDC title as he powered to a brilliant 16-11 victory over Gian van Veen in the Grand Slam of Darts final. The Welshman last won a major title when he claimed the World Series in 2022, but finally got over the line after defeats in three finals in 2026.

stories.title: Patients may miss out on NHS weight-loss jabs in England after GP funding withdrawn
stories.summary: Patients who are eligible for potentially life-changing weight-loss injections on the NHS risk missing out after most integrated care boards (ICBs) in England withdrew funding for GP services, an investigation has found. The inquiry, conducted by the GP magazine Pulse, found that 21 of 36 ICBs have scrapped payments to practices for prescribing and monitoring Mounjaro, also known as tirzepatide.

stories.title: Pip review will call for overhaul rather than scrapping benefit for under-25s
stories.summary: A long-awaited review of the personal independence payment (Pip) system will this week recommend that it is overhauled, a week after another report called for it to be partly scrapped. The final report on Pip by a committee co-led by Stephen Timms, the social security minister, is expected to be published as soon as Tuesday, presenting Andy Burnham with one of his most politically sensitive decisions yet as prime minister.

stories.title: Finance, fossil fuels and the ‘overshoot’: six key takeaways from Cop31
